lens: Penrose-method contemporary model-agent; no historical-person participation or endorsement
coverage: Five targeted primary sources: four 2024-2026 leads and one older directly relevant stability foundation. Not exhaustive SOTA coverage or a scientific priority determination.
production_status: Literature and prospective contract triage only; zero new research loops. AG2 frozen contract read, current producer reports not read. AH remains proposed; final two goals unselected.

sources.title: Block-diagonalization of infinite-volume lattice Hamiltonians with unbounded interactions
sources.source_class: Established primary mathematical-physics research; older foundation
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and publisher metadata; PDF pp. 2-4 assumptions and main theorem visually inspected; method overview. Full inductive proof not audited.
sources.premises: Gapped onsite product reference, unique onsite vacuum, finite-range uniformly relatively form-bounded interactions; sufficiently small coupling independent of volume.
sources.claim_scope: Positive gap stability; main theorem gives at least one half in normalized units for an existential small-coupling threshold.
sources.workbench_inference: Audit complete original interaction and applicability before importing stability. No evaluated workbench tau threshold or continuum Yang-Mills conclusion follows from this reading.

sources.title: A Fully Gauge-Fixed SU(2) Hamiltonian for Quantum Simulations
sources.source_class: Primary Hamiltonian gauge-theory formulation; accessed preprint
sources.reading_depth: Abstract, introduction, II.1 maximal-tree Hamiltonian through Eq. 21; residual-global construction overview; III.2 electric bilinear formulas, selected passages. Not all appendices audited.
sources.claim_scope: Sequestered coordinates isolate total charge after maximal-tree reduction and retain electric bilinears.
sources.workbench_inference: AH coordinate reduction must preserve full generator and domain as well as measure. Resource scaling is not a gap or error certificate.
sources.date_caveat: Experimental HTML header says 2026-08-24; arXiv submission history identifies v1 dated 2024-09-16. No later revision inferred.

sources.title: Accurate ground states of SU(2) lattice gauge theory in 2+1D and 3+1D
sources.source_class: Primary numerical lattice-gauge research; accessed preprint
sources.reading_depth: Main-text Hamiltonian, neural variational method, results and error discussion, sections I-III. Supplemental derivations not fully audited.
sources.premises: Continuous SU(2) representation, gauge-invariant variational ansatz and Monte Carlo optimization; reported Hamiltonian energies use a stated coupling-dependent rescaling.
sources.claim_scope: Variational energy and Wilson-observable benchmarks; Monte Carlo bars exclude optimization uncertainty.
sources.workbench_inference: A useful benchmark after scale matching; not a certified ground-energy lower bound, excitation gap or complete omitted-channel bound.

sources.title: Large N limit of Wilson Loops on orientable closed surfaces in the light of Koike-Schur-Weyl duality and Spin Networks
sources.reading_depth: PDF introduction, model and main theorems pp. 2-10; B.1.1-B.1.2 pp. 65-68, selected integration statements. Full proof not audited.
sources.premises: Two-dimensional orientable surface Yang-Mills measure; U(N)/SU(N), N tending to infinity. Appendix's basic Haar/Peter-Weyl identities apply to compact-group finite-graph representations.
sources.workbench_inference: Use explicit irreducible labels and intertwiners to certify Gram integrals; do not transfer surface topology or large-N convergence to four-dimensional fixed SU(2).
sources.text_caveat: Landing abstract says genus greater than two; v2 Theorems 2.5-2.6 say at least two. Specific versioned theorem controls scope.

sources.title: Spin networks of quantum channels
sources.reading_depth: Abstract, introduction, quantum-channel definitions and Kraus formulas, conclusion and stated open directions. Proposed inner-product construction not independently verified.
sources.premises: Environmental CPTP channels replacing unitary holonomies in generalized gauge-invariant spin-network states.
sources.claim_scope: State and Hilbert-space construction; generalized operator dynamics is left for future work.
sources.workbench_inference: Gauge covariance alone cannot justify replacing closed Hamiltonian dynamics by noise. Any such experiment needs a separately declared model deformation.
sources.date_caveat: Experimental HTML header says 2026-08-24; arXiv history dates v1 to 2026-02-12. No later revision inferred.
